turnaround_reason: Nutritional-snack roll-up (Quest/Atkins/OWYN) beaten down as Atkins collapses (retail takeaway -23%) and gross margin gets crushed ~460bps by ingredient inflation. Bull case is Quest chips/shakes strength plus a margin/brand reset stabilizing the top line.
bullish_points: Fwd P/E ~6 and P/B 0.64 — priced for continued decline
Quest chips and milkshakes growing double digits; OWYN still expanding despite reset
Positive FCF (~$107M) and clean-ish balance sheet (current ratio 4.8, net debt ~$325M)
Management reaffirmed FY2026 outlook and long-term algo (4-6% sales, ~20% EBITDA margin)
bearish_points: Atkins is 24% of sales and falling ~23% — structural, not cyclical
Gross margin contracted to 31.6% on ingredient inflation with no clear near-term relief
OWYN in a 6-12 month distribution reset after a product-quality issue
Revenue growth negative (-6.3% ttm); net margin negative on impairment
catalyst: Sequential gross-margin stabilization and Quest offsetting Atkins drag in upcoming quarterly prints
suggested_trade: Watch / small spot starter only below ~$10; no options
key_risk: Atkins decline accelerates and ingredient inflation persists, dragging margins lower before Quest can offset
would_skip_if: Skip if next print shows further GM contraction or Quest core bars roll over with Atkins
